messages:
Ivy: deploy-bot blocked todays prod promote — failing preflight: cache-write timeout when writing layer for service-images. tagging @Ops-Marco and @QA-Sam, this is in the 18:30 UTC change window.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Promote 9842 BLOCKED: cache-write.timeout for key=images/service-analytics/sha256:ff1122. write attempts exhausted on runners {staging-6, staging-7}.

Ops-Marco: looking now. Preliminary: PUT to storage returned 200 but writer hung on fsync for >30s before client returned. Could be disk or NFS flapping.

QA-Sam: Reproduced locally on staging-6 when simulating slow fsync. The promote fails in the post-build push phase.

Pedro: If we re-run CI it might pick a different runner and succeed, but that's noisy. Alternatives: 1) pin promote to last passing image tag (v2026-03-21-ff), 2) force promote with the already-uploaded partial object (unsafe), 3) re-trigger reupload from build cache on a healthy node and update manifest. What's the team's risk appetite?

Product-Kate: PM prefers not to skip the patch; this contains a customer-facing fix for session expiry. If reupload is quick, do that; otherwise pin and hotfix later.

Ivy: How long to reupload? Marco?

Ops-Marco: I can rsync the artifact from builder-11 (clean copy) to the artifact-store and ensure a successful complete. That should take ~4-6 minutes plus a smoke run. Safer than pinning.

QA-Sam: Note: after reupload we'll need to verify digest matches manifest. If we change object digest we'll also need to update the manifest and re-sign it. That adds 2-3m.

Ivy: Given PM wants the patch, let's try reupload first. If we miss the change window fallback to pin v2026-03-21-ff. I'll coordinate.

Ops-Marco: Starting rsync now from builder-11 -> s3://ci-artifacts/images/service-analytics/sha256/ff1122.tmp then complete. Capturing logs to /var/log/deploy/rsync-3250009999.log.

deploy-bot: [SYSTEM] New object observed: s3://ci-artifacts/images/service-analytics/sha256/ff1122 -> PUT completed by builder-11 (signature ok). Verifier: computed=ff1122 expected=ff1122.

QA-Sam: Verifier passed locally. Triggering promote retry.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Promote retry STARTED. Running smokes.

Ivy: quick smoke logs:
```
2026-03-23T18:31:02Z smoke: start
2026-03-23T18:31:08Z smoke: healthcheck service-analytics ok
2026-03-23T18:31:12Z smoke: migration noop
2026-03-23T18:31:14Z smoke: complete
```

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Promote retry PASSED. Promote completed.

Product-Kate: Awesome. Please add a release-note: "Promotion briefly paused due to cache-write timeout on staging; reuploaded artifact from builder-11 and completed promote. No customer impact observed."

Ivy: Filed INC-2026-140 to investigate flaky fsyncs on staging runners and artifact-store IO. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
